record.reason: Scope remains ambiguous after focused PDF review. RWC has mixed biomedical/chemical/social classification, molecular solubility and physical HOMO-LUMO regression; all ablations use NCI1/ZINC and sensitivity tests use ZINC. These indicate molecular empirical emphasis, but the PCQM4Mv2 physical-chemistry arm and substantial social benchmarks make biomedical primacy unresolved. Do not exclude from generic method framing or dataset counts alone.

record.title: Networked Restless Bandits with Positive Externalities
record.reason: Pending scope adjudication after PDF review: the model is explicitly grounded in chronic-disease exercise adherence with physician and peer support, and domain-motivated transition constraints. Biomedical motivation is substantive, but biomedical-primary empirical qualification is unresolved; do not treat the previous exclusion as confirmed.
